item.title: [NVDA Bearish (-0.29)] Nvidia Sentry's millisecond claim raises AI agent detection questions
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bearish (-0.29)
Nvidia's Sentry system promises millisecond containment of rogue AI agents, but security experts question the effectiveness of speed alone without rapid detection capabilities. The system differentiates containment from detection, raising concerns about potential damage an AI agent could cause before a threat is identified, especially when dealing with valid credentials or coordinated attacks. Critics suggest practical deployment tests are necessary to evaluate true protection.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.06)] Your CRM Was Built for a World Before AI. That’s Why Your Agents Keep Failing
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.06)
Many agentic AI projects fail not because of the AI models themselves, but due to incomplete, inaccurate, and unstructured data within CRM systems. CRM platforms were designed for human interpretation, allowing for inference and gap-filling, which AI agents cannot do. This fundamental mismatch between how CRMs store data and what AI needs for automated reasoning leads to underperformance and project cancellations.

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (+0.11)] Sanofi, Regeneron Expand DUPIXENT Alliance in Deal Worth Up to €8 Billion
item.description:
